reviews.title: Lost all my plans when I got a new phone
reviews.text: Cannot make second floor or roof plans. Children’s toy not good

reviews.title: Disappointing now, used to love it
reviews.text: I downloaded this app before and loved it. I spent hours upon hours designing my imaginative cabins and even modeled my own house down to every last detail. Now, I redownloaded it and had to rebuy the subscription because the last one was under my husbands iCloud… the app is buggy, basic items aren’t free anymore, and it’s too difficult to even use. I’m very unhappy.

reviews.title: DO NOT GET!
reviews.text: When I tried to go to my room it was missing? So I left to do a new one bc I needed a new room. But when I tried to leave or do anything it’s said something like “Sorry you have lite version, you need full version please buy at shop.” IT USED TO BE FREE COME ON!

reviews.title: Deletes everything
reviews.text:
Despite linking it with my iCloud, it just yeeted me out of my room - no chance to save or even look at what I’d done - the second the free trial was over. 
I get that you need to have a trial stage, but I have no idea if I want to buy the app or not because I ahve no idea what I made or whether it was any good, and now I’m just mad that it didn’t even warn me. 
Sad

reviews.title: Paywall PER ROOM FEE!
reviews.text: Don’t think if you buy the full version you’re done. No-no-no. You have to keep paying. These scammers are making you pay PER ROOM!

reviews.text: Yes, I can build a room plan with it just for fun but I can not add the floor, or add more than like two or three rooms without having to pay money…

reviews.title: There’s no such thing as a lite version anymore
reviews.text: The lite version exists only to frustrate you into buying the full version. You used to get the paint textures for free, now they locked ALL of them behind a paywall. They probably locked even more features behind a paywall but that’s where I stopped and deleted the game for good.

reviews.text: Most important thing is to be able to create the spaces to the right dimensions very difficult to complete with this

reviews.title: Would you buy a car without wheels
reviews.text: You can draw some wall and doors but it does not have folding doors or any of the modern fittings so it’s like very limited. Could be much better
